title: Declarative backend adapter
summary: Bind an allowlisted backend definition to trusted Host ports, validate its exact schemas and authority, and interpret read-only JSON steps with checked references and output schemas.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: compile
operations.notes: No deadline. Uses the registered backend definition's exact schemas; packages cannot override them.

operations.name: validate_authority
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

operations.name: invoke
operations.notes: No deadline. Exact port callbacks can propagate further LucError codes; that embedding-specific set is not closed here. Binding is revalidated before each call. An unavailable optional API may use its declared fallback data.

invariants.text: Backend definitions carry data plans over existing read APIs; they cannot widen permissions or edit authority.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: The adapter is reserved and its Official package is off; a declared runtime_bound flag is not proof a particular embedding attached working Host ports.
